cohort: Multiparous women aged 18 to 45 years with live-born twins without congenital anomalies, born between 26 and 42 weeks of gestation.
finding: Extreme interpregnancy intervals (IPI), either less than 6 months or 5 years or more, were associated with an increased risk of adverse perinatal outcomes in twin pregnancies.
followup_time: Up to 1 year after birth (for infant death)
